title: HCF
explanation: Highest common factor, also called GCD.

title: Prime-factor HCF
explanation: Use the minimum occurrences of common primes.

title: Prime-factor LCM
explanation: Use the maximum occurrences of all required primes.

title: HCF scaling
explanation: If both numbers are multiplied by a common factor, the HCF scales accordingly.

title: Product relation
explanation: HCF×LCM equals the product of two numbers.
